controlledPilotMvpEvidence.summary: The local controlled-pilot claim and its exclusions are explicit and versioned.
A versioned adapter contract, preflight, mandatory ten-case harness and replaceable ERPNext reference adapter are executable.
The frozen candidate completed model-backed build and fresh-process reuse against genuine disposable local ERPNext, with direct external-state verification.
The customer-local runtime resolves credential aliases, enforces authority, stops on missing credentials or permissions, and does not expose credential values in saved evidence.
Direct ERPNext checks independently detect partial outcomes; retry reconciliation, cleanup, duplicate prevention, and fail-closed behavior were exercised.
The durable authenticated sidecar, restart-safe jobs, real coordinator and operator console start together and expose the genuine local product path.
A detached clean checkout installed from the pinned lockfile, type-checked, passed 24/24 doctor checks, and started healthy console and sidecar endpoints with fresh state.
The frozen v3 commit passed the ten-case real-system campaign and both bounded model-backed confirmations without source changes.

evidenceBoundary: This is private local readiness evidence for one constrained HTTP capability mode. It is not a customer result, formal security audit, production reliability result, or the historical evaluation's formal final green verdict.
